name: TC-AN-QB-013 — 弹窗关闭方式：Escape/遮罩/关闭按钮 [P1]
description: 审核节点编辑页已打开
module: 审核管理/审核节点管理/参与人快捷按钮

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row'); if (rows.length > 0) { const editBtn = rows[0].querySelector('a[href*=edit], button'); if (editBtn) { editBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const batchBtn = btns.find(b => (b.textContent || '').includes('批量填写')); if (!batchBtn) return { clicked: false }; batchBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; })()
steps.description: 点击批量填写打开弹窗

steps.expression: (() => { /* 验证弹窗出现 */ const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal'); if (!modal) return { hasModal: false }; const closeBtn = modal.querySelector('.ant-modal-close'); return { hasModal: true, hasCloseBtn: !!closeBtn, hasMask: !!document.querySelector('.ant-modal-mask') }; })()
steps.description: 验证弹窗结构(关闭按钮+遮罩)

steps.expression: (() => { /* 按Escape键关闭弹窗 */ document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape', keyCode: 27, bubbles: true })); return { escapeSent: true }; })()
(() => { const modalRoot = document.querySelector('.ant-modal-root'); const visible = modalRoot && modalRoot.offsetHeight > 0; return { modalVisibleAfterEscape: visible }; })()

(() => { /* 如果弹窗还在，用取消按钮关闭 */ const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal'); if (modal) { const cancelBtn = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.trim().includes('取消')); if (cancelBtn) cancelBtn.click(); } return { dismissed: true }; })()

(() => { /* 再次打开弹窗，测试点击遮罩关闭 */ const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const batchBtn = btns.find(b => (b.textContent || '').includes('批量填写')); if (batchBtn) batchBtn.click(); return { reopened: true }; })()

(() => { /* 点击遮罩层 */ const mask = document.querySelector('.ant-modal-mask'); if (mask) { mask.click(); return { maskClicked: true }; } /* 尝试点击wrap */ const wrap = document.querySelector('.ant-modal-wrap'); if (wrap) { wrap.click(); return { wrapClicked: true }; } return { maskClicked: false }; })()
(() => { const modalRoot = document.querySelector('.ant-modal-root'); const visible = modalRoot && modalRoot.offsetHeight > 0; return { modalVisibleAfterMask: visible }; })()
steps.description: 验证遮罩点击后弹窗状态

_testDesign.preconditions: 审核节点编辑页已打开
_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 打开批量填写弹窗
2. 验证弹窗含关闭按钮和遮罩
3. 按Escape键关闭
4. 重新打开后点击遮罩层关闭
5. 重新打开后点击右上角X关闭
_testDesign.expectedResult: 1. 弹窗结构完整（有关闭按钮+遮罩层）\n2. Escape/遮罩点击/X按钮均可关闭弹窗\n3. 关闭后数据不变（未导入的内容不生效）
_testDesign.groupPath: 审核管理/审核节点管理/参与人快捷按钮
